method: 10 concurrent runs, 3 rounds, each run a gift check (POST /api/v1/check-gift, $1,000 as cash) then the gift page (GET /g/maya), after one warm-up request per path. Each run arrives as its own visitor (its own x-forwarded-for in 198.51.100.0/24), so the per-visitor demo limit sees 10 visitors at once. Latency is measured by the client from request start to the full body, with node's fetch on a laptop, over the internet.
machine: The deployed site: one Render Starter web service (0.5 CPU, 512 MB) and its Render Postgres, in Render's Oregon region; the client is a laptop (Intel(R) Core(TM) Ultra 9 185H, Node v24.13.1) on a home internet connection, so each time includes the network
